Announcement9 August 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
1.3.6 Preview - Primal Anthalon
Third post in our series of features on Discovery (1.3.6). Today's post presents Primal Anthalon.

In the upcoming 1.3.6 patch, Primal Anthalon will arrive as a new challenge for players to face.

Primal Anthalon, Leader of the Crimson Army

As the comet passed over Sungold Fields, Anthalon watched its blazing trail cross the night sky, sensing the immense power hidden within it.

Knowing the comet would descend upon Exeloch, he followed its path, determined to claim its fragments before they could fall into mortal hands. He seeks to harness their power and unleash chaos and destruction across Auroria.

Primal Kyrios Set

Primal Anthalon has a chance to drop one random piece of the Primal Kyrios set upon defeat.

The set features the antagonist's signature spell: Absorb Mind. The player has a 5% chance trigger the Absorb Mind effect by dealing any damage.

The following values are specific to the player version of Absorb Mind granted by the set:

Absorb Mind Value
Mind Grasp Range 15 meters
Teleport Range 20 meters
Number of Targets 10

The following affects differ from the original Absorb Mind spell:

  • Players affected by Absorb Mind are immune to all damage while levitated.
  • The mana burn effect from Anthalon's original Absorb Mind is not included.
  • The trip effect when the player falls is not included.

https://patch.aa-classic.com/vid/anth_lift.mp4

Unlocking Further Power

Through the use of a Primal Hallow, players can upgrade a piece of their Anthalon vestments into its Primal equivalent. The item's grade is retained upon upgrading.

The Primal Hallow is a guaranteed drop upon defeating Primal Anthalon.

Used in equipment crafting.

Any additional costs will not be revealed at this time.
